decisive_items: On day 9 of therapy, he reported loss of appetite and malaise, followed by generalized pruritus, dark urine, and jaundice
He was started on oral Alfuzosin 10 mg once daily.
total bilirubin 7.6 mg/dL (0.2–1.2), and direct bilirubin 5.8 mg/dL (0–0.25)
response.rationale: Temporal link to Alfuzosin plus hepatocellular and cholestatic lab pattern strongly supports drug-induced liver injury; cholestatic jaundice is a descriptive component, not the etiologic diagnosis.

rejected.why: Describes cholestatic pattern but lacks drug causality and temporal association.
Overlaps with R3 but less specific and no etiologic mechanism.
Only highlights elevated transaminases, missing cholestatic features and drug exposure.
